packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display the process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.

classes.name: Stakeholder
classes.definition: A party that takes part in the CDM process and originates or receives flight information.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The identifying name of the stakeholder.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline (AO) responsible for operating the flight, submitting the ATC Flight Plan, and providing TOBT and other turn-round estimates.

operations.name: provideTOBT
operations.description: The AO/GH provides the TOBT, calculated on the basis of the estimated/defined turn-round period, updated automatically or inserted manually (milestones 6,7,8).

operations.name: computeTOBTStrategy
operations.description: The Aircraft Operator integrates his own strategy to compute a TOBT related to the flight, providing the most accurate TOBT taking into account the operational situation (milestone 9).

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The party (GH), possibly including dispatcher/supervisor roles, that manages the turn-round process in coordination with the aircrew and provides TOBT and ready status.

operations.name: manageTurnRoundProcess
operations.description: The Ground Handler, in coordination with the aircrew, manages the turn-round process following TOBT confirmation and TSAT issue (milestones 9,10).

classes.name: AirTrafficControl
classes.definition: The air traffic control units (ATS units, Area Control Centre, Approach Control Unit, Tower) that provide radar detection, issue TSAT/start-up approval, and manage the pre-departure sequence.

operations.name: issueTSAT
operations.description: ATC issues the Target Start Up Approval Time t minutes before EOBT, a locally agreed parameter (milestone 10).

operations.name: approveStartUp
operations.description: ATC gives the aircraft its start up approval / push-back clearance (milestone 14).

operations.name: establishPushBackSequence
operations.description: An accurate TOBT at EOBT-t minutes is a pre-requisite for ATC to establish a push back / pre-departure sequence (milestone 9).

operations.name: calculateEXOT
operations.description: Following receipt of TOBT, the ATC system calculates and provides the Estimated Taxi-Out Time based on the predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position (milestone 9).

operations.name: refineSequence
operations.description: ATC refines the pre-departure sequence once the aircraft is ready (milestone 12).

operations.name: confirmTSATToPilot
operations.description: ATC confirms TSAT to the pilot in order to maintain the aircraft in the pre-departure sequence (milestone 13).

operations.name: reSequenceFlight
operations.description: If start-up approval is not granted at TSAT+tolerance, the flight is re-sequenced (milestone 14).

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network operations function that issues CTOT for regulated flights, monitors flight progress, and receives DPI/FUM messages.

operations.name: issueCTOT
operations.description: If the flight is regulated, Network Operations issues a CTOT at EOBT-2h, sent to relevant ATS units and the departure aerodrome; CTOT flights usually have priority over unregulated flights (milestone 2).

operations.name: monitorFlightProgress
operations.description: Within 3 hours flying time of the destination, Network Operations monitors progress of the flight using ETFMS and sends a Flight Update Message (milestone 3).

classes.name: AirportOperator
classes.definition: The airport authority / stand-gate management function responsible for the airport slot programme and airport flight data.

classes.name: Aircrew
classes.definition: The flight crew (pilot) that requests start-up and coordinates with the Ground Handler.

operations.name: requestStartUp
operations.description: The pilot requests start up just before TSAT, following coordination with the Ground Handler, by voice or DCL (milestones 12,13,14).

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: A single flight movement, arriving or departing, tracked through the sixteen milestones of the CDM turn-round process.

attributes.name: aircraftRegistration
attributes.description: The registration of the aircraft operating the flight, confirmed via the ATC Flight Plan (milestone 1).

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Whether the flight is the arriving or departing flight of a turn-round (milestone 1).

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: The current operational status of the flight, changed at each milestone (e.g. INITIATED, AIRBORNE, FIR, FINAL, LANDED, IN-BLOCK, SEQUENCED, BOARDING, READY, OFF-BLOCK, DEPARTED / TAKE OFF).

attributes.name: regulated
attributes.description: Whether the flight is regulated and has received a CTOT; regulated flights usually have priority over unregulated flights (milestone 2).

attributes.name: flightReadyTime
attributes.description: The flight is ready not later than 15 minutes after the planned EOBT (milestone 1).

operations.name: updateOperationalStatus
operations.description: Changes the flight's operational status as each milestone occurs.

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The turn-round of an aircraft, which normally includes an arriving and a departing flight.

attributes.name: minimumTurnRoundTime
attributes.description: MTTT, the minimum/estimated turn-round period used as the basis for TOBT/TTOT calculation, e.g. EIBT+MTTT+EXOT (milestones 2,3,6,7,8).

classes.name: ATCFlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO flight plan submitted to ATC and distributed by IFPS, describing the flight's aerodromes and estimates, corresponding to the airport slot programme.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Whether this is a standard flight plan or a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights (milestone 1).

attributes.name: departureAerodrome
attributes.description: The departure aerodrome (ADEP) of the flight (milestone 1).

attributes.name: destinationAerodrome
attributes.description: The destination aerodrome of the flight (milestone 1).

attributes.name: sobt
attributes.description: The Scheduled Off-Block Time that must be consistent before the first E-DPI is sent (milestone 1).

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot programme entry that the ATC Flight Plan must correspond to.

attributes.name: coordinationStatus
attributes.description: Whether the airport is coordinated (outbound flight already known) or non-coordinated (flight plan used to initiate the outbound flight) (milestone 1).

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The aircraft assigned to operate the flight, whose type may be updated from the flight plan.

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: The aircraft registration (milestone 1).

attributes.name: aircraftType
attributes.description: The type of aircraft, which the flight plan may be used to update (milestone 1).

classes.name: AirportFlightData
classes.definition: The airport's own flight data record checked for consistency against the ATC Flight Plan and Airport Slot.

attributes.name: gateStandAllocation
attributes.description: The airport's recorded gate/stand information for the flight, checked for consistency (milestone 1).

classes.name: TimeQuantity
classes.definition: A time value describing a flight's progress, carrying its prefix, origin, accuracy, and update time; every successive value is kept rather than overwritten so a turn-round can be analysed afterwards.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The time value itself.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Whether this is the scheduled, estimated, target, actual, or calculated value of the event.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: Who or what system provided this value, e.g. ATC, AO/GH, ACARS, ATC system.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The stated accuracy of the value, e.g. actual times are available with an accuracy of +/- 1 minute.

attributes.name: updateTime
attributes.description: The time this value was recorded.

operations.name: recordValue
operations.description: Appends a new time value with its originator and time of update, rather than overwriting the previous value, so the turn-round can be analysed afterwards.

classes.name: OffBlockTime
classes.definition: The scheduled (SOBT), estimated (EOBT), target (TOBT), or actual (AOBT) off-block time of a flight.

attributes.name: toleranceWindow
attributes.description: The locally agreed tolerance window applied to TOBT, e.g. checked t minutes before EOBT, or TSAT/TOBT update tolerance windows (milestones 9,10).

classes.name: InBlockTime
classes.definition: The estimated (EIBT) or actual (AIBT) in-block time of an arriving flight.

operations.name: calculateEIBT
operations.description: EIBT is computed using the ELDT and the estimated taxi-in time EXIT (milestone 4); EIBT can also be updated according to ALDT+EXIT (milestone 6).

classes.name: LandingTime
classes.definition: The estimated (ELDT) or actual (ALDT) landing time of an arriving flight.

operations.name: calculateELDT
operations.description: Using the ATOT, an ELDT can be calculated by using the Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL (milestone 3).

classes.name: TakeOffTime
classes.definition: The estimated (ETOT), target (TTOT), calculated (CTOT), or actual (ATOT) take-off time of a departing flight.

operations.name: calculateTTOT
operations.description: Calculation basis for TTOT takes into account EIBT+MTTT+EXOT, if later than EOBT+EXOT (milestone 2); in case EOBT is later than EIBT+MTTT, TTOT equals EOBT+EXOT (milestone 3); in the case of manual input of TOBT, this estimate overrides the EIBT+MTTT estimate, hence TTOT equals TOBT+EXOT (milestones 2,3).

classes.name: StartUpApprovalTime
classes.definition: The target (TSAT) or actual (ASAT) start-up approval time.

classes.name: StartUpRequestTime
classes.definition: The actual start-up request time (ASRT).

classes.name: ReadyTime
classes.definition: The actual ready time (ARDT), when all doors are closed and the aircraft is ready to taxi upon reception of TWR instructions.

classes.name: BoardingTime
classes.definition: The actual start boarding time (ASBT), when the gate opens for passengers to physically start boarding.

classes.name: GroundHandlingTime
classes.definition: The actual commence ground handling time (ACGT); for a normal turn-round ACGT is considered to commence at AIBT, but this milestone applies specifically to first-operation-of-day or long-term parked flights.

classes.name: TaxiOutTime
classes.definition: The estimated taxi-out time (EXOT), calculated by ATC based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use, and waiting period at the Holding Position.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The estimated taxi-out duration used in TTOT calculation (EOBT+EXOT, TOBT+EXOT).

classes.name: TaxiInTime
classes.definition: The estimated taxi-in time (EXIT) used to compute the estimated in-block time.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The estimated taxi-in duration used in EIBT calculation (ELDT+EXIT, ALDT+EXIT).

classes.name: Milestone
classes.definition: One of the sixteen defined events of the CDM turn-round process, each with a trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

attributes.name: definition
attributes.description: The document's definition of the milestone.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: What triggers this milestone's procedure, as stated under Procedures.

attributes.name: timingRule
attributes.description: When the milestone normally occurs, as stated under Timing.

attributes.name: effect
attributes.description: The effect described for the milestone.

attributes.name: resultingStatus
attributes.description: The operational status the flight changes to at this milestone.

operations.name: occur
operations.description: Records the occurrence of the milestone for the flight and changes its operational status.

operations.name: informPartners
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners, a step stated under most milestones' procedures.

classes.name: FlightPlanActivated
classes.definition: Milestone 1: the ICAO flight plan is submitted to ATC and the Airport CDM Platform is initiated for the flight.

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot, and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent.

operations.name: confirmFlightToNetworkOperations
operations.description: Confirms the flight to Network Operations and allows further local processing of the flight.

operations.name: sendFirstEDPI
operations.description: Feeds Network Operations with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration, and first destination data; the E-DPI message should not be sent if no or inconsistent information is provided.

classes.name: EOBTMinus2Hours
classes.definition: Milestone 2: at EOBT-2hr most flights are known and all regulated flights receive a CTOT from Network Operations.

operations.name: checkFlightEstimatesConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, before or after take-off from outstation, to verify feasibility of the estimated off-block time at EOBT-2hrs.

operations.name: sendFirstTDPI
operations.description: Informs Network Operations about the updated take-off time estimate using a T-DPI message at EOBT-2hrs.

operations.name: markAsRegulated
operations.description: Marks appropriate fields as REGULATED for a flight that has received a CTOT.

classes.name: TakeOffFromOutstation
classes.definition: Milestone 3: the ATOT from the outstation (ADEP).

operations.name: checkLandingEstimateConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH estimated landing time after take-off from outstation is consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: sendTDPIt
operations.description: When needed, informs Network Operations about updated take-off time estimates using a T-DPI-t message; a TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes is respected before informing.

classes.name: LocalRadarUpdate
classes.definition: Milestone 4: the flight enters the FIR or local airspace of the destination airport.

operations.name: commenceTOBTProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated ELDT.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChanges
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

operations.name: restrictStandGateChange
operations.description: Taking into account EXIT, any change to a stand or gate is not preferred after ELDT-30'.

classes.name: FinalApproach
classes.definition: Milestone 5: the flight enters the Final Approach phase at the destination airport, usually 2 to 5 minutes from landing.

operations.name: commenceTOBTProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated ELDT.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChanges
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: Landed
classes.definition: Milestone 6: ALDT, the time an aircraft touches down on a runway.

operations.name: recordALDT
operations.description: ALDT triggers an update of downstream estimates: TOBT and TTOT updated automatically or inserted manually by AO/GH, calculated on the basis of the defined turn-round period; EIBT updated according to ALDT+EXIT.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChanges
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: InBlock
classes.definition: Milestone 7: AIBT, the time an aircraft arrives in-blocks.

operations.name: recordAIBT
operations.description: AIBT triggers an update of downstream estimates: TOBT and TTOT updated automatically or inserted manually by AO/GH, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChanges
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: GroundHandlingStarted
classes.definition: Milestone 8: commencement of ground handling operations (ACGT), specific to first-operation-of-day or long-term parked flights.

operations.name: recordACGT
operations.description: ACGT triggers an update of downstream estimates: TOBT updated automatically or inserted manually by AO/GH, calculated on the basis of the estimated turn-round period.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given the updated TOBT or ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChanges
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: FinalConfirmationOfTOBT
classes.definition: Milestone 9: the time at which the Aircraft Operator or Ground Handler provide their most accurate TOBT, taking into account the operational situation.

operations.name: confirmTOBT
operations.description: The AO/GH provide their most accurate TOBT t minutes before EOBT (t a locally agreed parameter), a pre-requisite for ATC to establish the pre-departure sequence prior to TSAT issue.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether the AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan; performed at a predefined local time to confirm TOBT prior to TSAT issue.

operations.name: notifyNetworkOperationsIfTTOTChanges
operations.description: Network Operations is informed when the TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: TSATIssued
classes.definition: Milestone 10: the time ATC issues the Target Start Up Approval Time.

operations.name: issueTSAT
operations.description: Informs all relevant partners of the TSAT allocated to the flight, t minutes before EOBT (a locally agreed parameter); stabilises the flight into the pre-departure sequence.

operations.name: sendTDPIs
operations.description: Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non-regulated flights.

operations.name: checkTOBTUpdateCount
operations.description: Checks whether the number of TOBT updates after TSAT has been issued exceeds a locally defined threshold; if exceeded, the TOBT input is processed according to local procedure.

classes.name: BoardingStarts
classes.definition: Milestone 11: the gate is open for passengers to physically start boarding.

operations.name: recordASBT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of the Actual Start Boarding Time when it occurs.

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: At a certain local time before TOBT (e.g. by aircraft type), checks whether boarding starts in time to respect TOBT and informs the AO/GH if TOBT needs to be updated.

classes.name: AircraftReady
classes.definition: Milestone 12: the time when all doors are closed, boarding bridge removed, push back vehicle connected, ready to taxi upon reception of TWR instructions (ARDT).

operations.name: recordARDT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Ready Time and that the aircraft is ready for start up / push-back.

operations.name: checkReadyStatusReceived
operations.description: At TOBT + tolerance, informs the AO/GH that TOBT has passed and the Airport CDM Platform has not yet received ARDT or Ready Status (RDY).

classes.name: StartUpRequested
classes.definition: Milestone 13: the time that start up is requested (ASRT), based on pilot request.

operations.name: recordASRT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start-up Request Time when it occurs.

operations.name: alertIfNoStartUpRequested
operations.description: If the start-up request is not made by TSAT + tolerance, informs the AO/GH that no start-up has been requested, and that TOBT should be updated.

classes.name: StartUpApproved
classes.definition: Milestone 14: ASAT, the time an aircraft receives its start up approval.

operations.name: recordASAT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual start up approval Time and that the aircraft has received start up / push-back clearance.

operations.name: checkASATAgainstTSAT
operations.description: Checks if ASAT is in accordance with TSAT; if start-up approval is not granted at TSAT + tolerance, all relevant partners are informed and the flight is re-sequenced.

classes.name: OffBlock
classes.definition: Milestone 15: AOBT, the time the aircraft pushes back / vacates the parking position.

operations.name: recordAOBT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Off-Block Time and that the aircraft has commenced push-back / taxi from parking position.

operations.name: sendADPI
operations.description: AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations, or in the case of remote holding at a defined time prior to TTOT.

operations.name: checkTTOTChangeAndNotify
operations.description: After the first A-DPI is sent, checks TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before informing Network Operations, with a new A-DPI, of the updated TTOT.

classes.name: TakeOff
classes.definition: Milestone 16: ATOT, the time an aircraft takes off from the runway.

operations.name: recordATOT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take off, triggered by Tower FDPS, A-SMGCS / Radar detection or ACARS.

operations.name: generateAirborneMessage
operations.description: An airborne message is generated and the flight is removed from the departure sequence.

operations.name: sendFSAAndMVT
operations.description: FSA and MVT messages are sent.

classes.name: AirportCDMPlatform
classes.definition: The central platform that is initiated for each flight, processes all available information, and holds the CDM operation actions performed at each milestone.

attributes.name: initiated
attributes.description: Whether the platform has been initiated for the flight (milestone 1).

operations.name: initiateForFlight
operations.description: The Airport CDM Platform is initiated for this flight, and all available information is processed (milestone 1).

operations.name: updateField
operations.description: Updates fields such as ELDT, EIBT, ETOT, TOBT, TTOT, AOBT, ATOT as listed under each milestone's Action on CDM Operation.

operations.name: markFieldAsRegulated
operations.description: Marks appropriate fields as REGULATED (milestone 2).

classes.name: ATCSystem
classes.definition: The ATC/radar system, including A-SMGCS and Tower FDPS, that detects a flight crossing FIR/TMA boundaries or levels using its assigned SSR code, and provides ALDT, AIBT, AOBT, and ATOT.

operations.name: detectFlight
operations.description: Detects a flight based upon the assigned SSR code when it crosses a defined FIR/ATC boundary (milestone 4) or a defined range/position or level on Final Approach (milestone 5).

classes.name: ACARS
classes.definition: The aircraft's ACARS system that reports ON/OFF/OUT/IN events, providing ATOT, ALDT, AIBT, and AOBT.

classes.name: ETFMS
classes.definition: Network Operations' system used to monitor the progress of a flight within 3 hours flying time of the destination and to generate Flight Update Messages.

classes.name: IFPS
classes.definition: The system that distributes the ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units, including departure and destination aerodromes.

classes.name: DPIProcess
classes.definition: The messaging process that commences correct DPI messaging with Network Operations following flight plan activation.

operations.name: commenceMessaging
operations.description: The DPI process commences the correct messaging with Network Operations, if implemented (milestone 1).

classes.name: Message
classes.definition: A message exchanged between stakeholders and systems in the CDM process.

attributes.name: sender
attributes.description: The party or system that sent the message.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: When the message was sent.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The content carried by the message.

classes.name: DPIMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message sent to Network Operations at defined points of the process.

attributes.name: dpiType
attributes.description: Which kind of DPI message this is: E-DPI, T-DPI, T-DPI-t, T-DPI-s, or A-DPI.

classes.name: FUM
classes.definition: The Flight Update Message sent by Network Operations providing updates of the flight's progress.

classes.name: MVTMessage
classes.definition: The movement message sent when a flight takes off.

classes.name: FSAMessage
classes.definition: The FSA message sent when a flight takes off.

classes.name: AirborneMessage
classes.definition: The airborne message generated when the flight departs, after which the flight is removed from the departure sequence.
